ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If the Algae died, what would happen to the Snail population?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-web diagram shows Algae at the bottom. Snail is on the right side. There is an arrow pointing from Algae toward Snail. Reasoning: In a food web, an arrow points from the food or resource to the organism that eats or depends on it. Since the arrow goes from Algae to Snail, Snails depend on Algae as a food source. If the Algae died, Snails would lose that food source, so the Snail population would decrease.
